clinic.name: Larkfield Clinic
clinic.tagline: A family practice in Larkfield since 1998

doctors.name: Dr Amara Okafor
doctors.bio: Joined Larkfield in 2009. Looks after long-term conditions and women's health; speaks English and Igbo.

doctors.name: Dr Tom Hale
doctors.bio: The practice's senior partner. Minor surgery on Tuesday afternoons; a special interest in diabetes.

doctors.name: Dr Inês Barros
doctors.bio: Children and families; the Saturday clinic is hers. Speaks English and Portuguese.

doctors.name: Sam Whitfield
doctors.bio: Vaccinations, blood tests, dressings and travel advice. No referral needed.

doctors.name: Dr Lena Voss
doctors.bio: Mental health and sports injuries. Trained in Hamburg and Leeds.

doctors.name: Ravi Menon
doctors.bio: Backs, knees and shoulders; a first visit takes 40 minutes.

news.title: Flu vaccinations have started
news.text: Book with the nurse; walk-ins on Saturday mornings until the end of November.

news.title: Wednesday afternoons
news.text: From October the clinic closes at 13:00 on Wednesdays for staff training.

news.title: Dr Voss joins the practice
news.text: Dr Lena Voss sees patients on Tuesdays and Thursdays from this month.
